_note: VWJ (Vector-Wrist-Joint) retargeting weights, clean-room reimplementation of arXiv:2506.09384 (Mingrui-Yu/retargeting), LEAP profile. Hot-reloadable: edit + save while the sim runs.
_joint_position_weights_note: REMAPPED to this repo's LEAP joint order [mcp,rot,pip,dip] per finger. Upstream's Paxini order is [side,mcp,pip,dip], so its side-joint regs (0.5) must land on the *_rot joints here, NOT *_mcp. The verbatim upstream vector regularized the MCP FLEXION joints toward a curled home, which stopped fingers (esp. middle) from uncurling. Now: if_rot/mf_rot/rf_rot=0.5 (anti-splay), rf_dip=0.5, th_mcp=0.1.
_joint_limit_overrides_note: Upstream clamps the PIP+DIP of index/middle/ring fingers to >=0 (no hyperextension). Opt-vector indices 9,10=if_pip,if_dip; 13,14=mf_pip,mf_dip; 17,18=rf_pip,rf_dip. Same numeric indices as the upstream LEAP profile (arm[0:7]+LEAP[7:23] order matches).
